decision_rules: Written 2026-11-22 before the run vote-1.json (fl_ab.py, 3 rounds, held to the P-cores):
builds base (prev-5490c4e), new (new1.exe: groups of lanes, no vote), vote (vote-proto.exe: + __any_sync vote,
lanes by precision 8/16), vL8 and vL16 (vote-proto.exe with FORCE_LANES=8 / 16 for every precision), base2.
Rules, on the forces stage medians, spread = |base2/base - 1| of the same case:
1. The vote goes in if, on no case, vote is slower than new by more than the spread (and 1%).
2. Lanes in float64: 16 stay if vL8 is not faster than vote on the HAP float64 cases (hap0-f64, ens4-f64, h169-f64,
h224-f64) by more than the spread; otherwise 8 in float64 if it does not lose more than the spread on w1536-f64
and w12288-f64; if the two disagree, the one that loses to base nowhere.
3. Lanes in float32 stay 8 (the looked-up and stored paths must sum alike); vL16 on w1536-nt only tells what the
4. If HAP float64 with the chosen lanes is slower than base beyond the spread: stop, rethink the float64 mapping.

ways.what:
ways.py OLD NEW OUT.json [ROUNDS]: the force blocks chosen by the blocks the device keeps at once, before and after,
with every way forced (2026-11-22).

Two builds of omnimd-native-gpu-eval: OLD (the limits of centers) twice a round (`old`, `old again`: what the two
differ by is what the machine adds), NEW as it is (`new`) and NEW with each way of the force kernel forced
(--wide-forces 1000000 or 0 with --block-sums 1000000 or 0: `wide+sums`, `narrow+sums`, `wide`, `narrow`).
Alternated in ROUNDS rounds (5), the order reversed every other round, the least of each kept. Cases: the trained
HAP models (se_e2_a, se_e2_r, a hybrid with se_e3, a committee of four) on batches of the sealed-test frames, and
the water models on batches of 192 waters and on 1,536, in float32 and float64, with tables (--compress 0.5) and
for se_e2_a in float32 also without; sizes on both sides of what the device keeps of each way. `centers` are the
atoms of a pass times its models. The card is checked for other users before every round (tools/ht/gpu_busy.ps1).
`way_of_new`: the way of the last two-body pass of `new`, from the bench lines (`force_threads`, `force_sums`; the
build of the first run printed `block_sums` instead, which is that of the force kernel launched last: in the hybrid,
the one of se_e3, which forms the sums in every pass). The forced ways of the hybrid set the sums of se_e3 as well.
Environment: ONLY (words of case names, by comma).

phases_before.what:
fl_ab.py OUT.json ROUNDS CASES LABEL=EXE[@VAR=VAL;VAR=VAL] ...: builds and settings alternated on force-kernel cases.

CASES, joined by ',': w<atoms>[-f64][-nt] (water se_e2_a, float32 with tables unless -f64 / -nt: no tables),
hap<k> (HAP model k of hap-iter0-pre/ens4-f32 on the 88-atom frame, float32 with tables), ens4 (the committee of
four on 88 atoms), h169 and h169x3 (one and three HAP models on the 169-atom frame), h224 (one on monetite, 224
atoms); -f64 after a HAP case: float64 (tables stored, the default). Every round runs every build on every case,
builds in order and reversed every other round, each run `--bench K --profile`; the evaluation time is the bench
loop's (no marks), the stage times the profile loop's. Records the header `force blocks at once` per build and
case. Run it held to the P-cores (tools/pk/affine.py 0xFFFC).
phases_before.note: Builds of 5490c4e (the kernel before this change) with probes: OMNIMD_FORCE_PROBE=stop:repeats launches the force kernel of se_e2_a `repeats` (4) more times before its own launch, each returning after step `stop` (1 at entry, 2 after the copy of B and the pieces of the slots, 3 after dB, 4 after the slots, 5 after the Jacobians, 0 all of it); the stop travels in the high bits of `add`, so no phase is compiled away. The kernel up to a stop is (forces(stop) - forces(none)) / 4. probe2 and probe3 add flags to the launches stopped after phase 2, phase 2 under a flag being (forces(4:4:flag) - forces(3:4)) / 4 of the same probe build: 1 every slot of a block reads the row of slot 0 (probe2), 2 the coefficients of a table read across the lanes, 4 no sums over the warp, 8 no tangent (probe3). Medians of the forces stage, us.
